package: K35-T2 idempotent retry of Studio multipart completion

result.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17.11 after all 84 Prisma migrations; container stopped after test
result.scenario: Repeat the same authenticated complete request after the first request has committed, modeling a client that cannot rely on its first response.
assertions: retry returns HTTP 200 and the same encode job ID
retry makes no additional object-storage requests
exactly one encode job exists for the original

limitations: This validates retry after a committed success, not process termination or network loss at every intermediate storage/database boundary.
Storage is a loopback S3-shaped fixture, not real Cloudflare R2; no deployed edge Worker was used.
K35-T2 and K35-T1 remain partial; full role/state matrix and independent review remain open.
